description: Write (treat as a sensitive, purchase-starting action; confirm the product and amount with the person first). Creates a secure Stripe-hosted checkout link for a contribution toward testing one crowdfunding product. Nothing is charged by this call: the person must open checkout_url and pay. Returns the amount, currency, seller, refund terms, and expiry. Use get_checkout_status to see whether they paid.

amount.description: Whole US dollars; must be within the product’s contribution range (minimum $5, or less if less remains).

idempotency_key.description: Optional key; repeating a call with the same key and arguments returns the same checkout instead of a new one.

name: create_contribution_checkout
title: Create contribution checkout link
